2653-5702-6973-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5702-6973-8345.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

341-586-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
341-586-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6495-7286.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-7286.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

877-3184-3967-4645.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

2933-4499-7824.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-4871-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1069-1169-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1169-2457-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

141-5147-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

2034-4871-5147-6970.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for Abby's commander tax
2034-4871-5147-6970.notablePrerequisites: Abby's commander tax is at least {2}.
2034-4871-5147-6970.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Cordyceps Infected creature tokens.
Resolve Abby, giving control of it to an opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing four Cordyceps Infected tokens, dealing 4 damage to Abby.
Abby dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Cordyceps Infected tokens die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cordyceps Infected token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 8 until you control no Cordyceps Infected tokens and/or have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

997-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

413-2425-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-2425-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1432-1486-1753-5929.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
1432-1486-1753-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability. You can also use Ioreth's second ability instead.

586-2921-5626-5687.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

575-897-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian, adding {R}.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1137-2882-3624-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Rith's Attendant.
1137-2882-3624-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Rith's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Flourishing Fox by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
If you cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

409-2104-4797.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-2104-4797.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

404-1322-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
You control at least one creature token.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1322-3259.description:
Declare Ghired and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Ghired triggers, creating a token copy of a creature token you control that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token you control, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1328-3398-4276.notablePrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to a creature that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Hellkite Charger and the creature with Spellbinder attached can attack this turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
1328-3398-4276.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, triggering Hellkite Charger.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Turnabout without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Turnabout, untapping all tapped lands you control.
Repeat each combat phase.

728-1424.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1424.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
